correctness.rationale: For Paley P13, edges have differences ±1,±3,±4. Its clique triangles are exactly translates of {0,1,4} and {0,3,4}, with 13 vertices, 39 edges, 26 triangles, six-cycle links and no four-cliques. These identify its flag complex as the universal triangular lattice divided by L={(a,b):a+3b≡0 mod13}. The triangular edge generators ±e1,±e2,±(e1+e2) give the exact all-class edge-walk length max(|a|,|b|,|a-b|); this follows from both 1-Lipschitz coordinate bounds and explicit axial/diagonal paths, not finite testing. L has no nonzero vector of norm≤3 and exactly ±(3,-1), ±(1,4), ±(4,3) at norm4, all primitive, first two determinant13. Every minimal vector forces three steps of one type plus one of another, yielding 13 distinct simple cycle carriers for each of three unoriented types. Independent enumeration gave 78 total 4-cycles, 39 zero-class and 39 nonzero with counts 13 each; translations and multiplier4 transitively permute them. Distinction between shortest closed walks for any w and census of simple essential 4-cycles is respected.
residual_risks: Marked length formula concerns closed edge walks for all classes, not a complete simple-carrier census beyond shortest nonzero shell.
Not a statement about all Paley graphs or minimal triangulations of torus.
